touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Belton qualifies as a local detour through The Trolleybus Museum at Sandtoft and MILL TOWER AT THE WINDMILL. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Belton: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Belton offers The Trolleybus Museum at Sandtoft, MILL TOWER AT THE WINDMILL, Church of All Saints within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: The Trolleybus Museum at Sandtoft
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with The Trolleybus Museum at Sandtoft and MILL TOWER AT THE WINDMILL, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
